An app on your computer,
a plugin in Figma.

The app connects your AI and keeps your standards. The plugin is where the drawing lands.

  1. Your AI
  2. →Reqwise Figma app
  3. →Plugin in your Figma file
  4. →Real layers you can edit

The app

Runs quietly in the background

  • Connects your AIs. Finds the AIs on your computer, writes their settings and keeps a backup you can undo.
  • Runs inside your project’s AI agent. The AI draws with the code, specs and conventions already in the project folder, no retelling.
  • Keeps your diagram style. Ten looks and your own, set for the app, one file or one diagram type.
  • Guides for the AI. 90 features, edited in the app. Turn off the groups you don’t use and the AI reads less.
  • Key, devices and updates. Move a licence to another device, update in the background.

The Figma plugin

Open it in any file

  • Shows what is connected. Which AI sessions are working in this file, and moves one here with a click.
  • Builds a design system. From your brand colour to 412 variables and text styles, compared with what the file already has.
  • Links components to code. Each Figma component maps to a React or Vue file, and drift shows up on both sides.
  • Shows it to clients. Plays self-running demos in Figma and saves a clickable HTML prototype.

Set up in about 3 minutes.

What your AI can do in Figma.

90 features in the four groups the app uses: Diagrams, Screens, Hand-off to developers, Check and present. These four are where people start.

13 diagram types

Ask in plain words or paste Mermaid. Each model is checked: steps with no owner, tables with no key, dead-end states, BPMN that breaks the standard.

  • Userflow
  • BPMN 2.0
  • Activity
  • Sequence
  • State
  • ERD
  • Use case
  • Sitemap
  • Journey map
  • Persona
  • Mindmap
  • Gantt
  • Architecture

Before you buy

What you need
A Mac with macOS 13 or later or Windows 10 / 11; the Figma desktop app (the free plan works) and a supported AI.
Activation
Install the app, click “Open the app and activate” in your email (or paste the key). The app connects your AIs and adds the plugin to Figma.
Devices
Plans for 1, 3 or 5 devices. Upgrading only costs the difference.
Free trial
Enter your email at the store and a 30-day key lands in your inbox. Every feature, no card; one trial per email and per device.
Payment
Bank transfer by QR code, with a company invoice if you need one. Your key arrives by email as soon as the payment lands.
Refunds
Full refund within 14 days, no questions asked.
What happens after 12 months?
The app keeps working. You stop getting new versions until you renew updates, at 40% of your plan.
Do my Figma files leave my computer?
No. Your AI works on your computer. Only your key and a device ID go online, to check the licence.
